title: Onto Innovation Announces $400 Million Share Repurchase Program
summary: Onto Innovation's board authorized a new share repurchase program of up to $400 million, replacing the prior program authorized in February 2024.
body_markdown:
Share repurchases, if any, will be funded using available cash, the company said. They will be made through open market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, or by any other means. The release states that the timing, volume and nature of repurchases are subject to market prices and conditions, applicable securities laws and other factors, and that repurchases may be commenced, suspended, or discontinued at any time at the discretion of the Board of Directors.


## Why It Matters for ONTO


Chief executive officer Mike Plisinski linked the program to the company's approach to returning capital. "We are committed to a disciplined long-term capital return strategy for our shareholders, balancing inorganic investments and share repurchase programs to maximize returns," he said in the release. He added that "the increase in the size of our repurchase program reflects our confidence in our company performance and the industry outlook." The release does not state the size of the February 2024 program.


Onto Innovation, headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, describes itself as a leader in process control. According to the release, its portfolio includes 3D metrology, macro defect inspection of wafers and packages, factory analytics and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging.
